title: MaxSource
description: MAXGEN v1.7 — Maxwell Genealogy Standard. A SOURCE-DISCOVERY entry: a neutral, catalogued pointer to WHERE genealogy data lives (place + record-type + period + language), not the data itself. Any tool may use MaxSource to exchange source-location intelligence; a corpus of MaxSource records can be embedded into a vector DB to answer 'where do I find records for X?'. Describes any source — archives, research wikis, record catalogs, openly-licensed indexes. IP/REDISTRIBUTION GUARDRAIL: uses the standard MAXGEN `redistribution_license` enum; entries marked `tier2-private` MUST NOT appear in any open dataset, public share, export, API response, public embedding, or commit (this is how a privately-held routing entry derived from a third party's curated directory is kept internal). Product/implementation specifics (harvester adapters, query routing, ranking) live in `extensions{}`, never in the core, to keep the standard neutral. MaxSource never stores genealogical facts about persons.

source_id.description: Globally unique identifier for this source entry.

schema_version.description: MAXGEN version this record conforms to.

name.description: Human-readable name of the source, e.g. 'FamilySearch Research Wiki — Pomerania' or 'Cyndi's List — Germany / Church Records'.

source_url.description: Canonical URL of the source or the specific category/page within it.

source_type.description: What KIND of source this is. directory_index = a curated link list (Cyndi's List). research_wiki = MediaWiki locality/record articles (FS Research Wiki). record_catalog = catalogue queried by place (FS Catalog).

redistribution_license.description: Whether this source entry may be redistributed — same enum as MaxRecord. tier2-private = a privately-held routing entry that MUST NEVER appear in any open dataset, public share, export, public embedding, API response, or commit (e.g. an entry derived from a third party's curated, copyrighted directory and used only as an internal routing seed). Openly-licensed or OGAI-original entries (CC0/CC-BY/CC-BY-SA/public-domain) MAY appear in the public OGAI source directory.

description.description: Free-text summary of what this source holds and who it serves. Primary human-readable context.

embedding_text.description: Denormalized natural-language text built from name + description + coverage, embedded into the vector DB so a query like 'German Lutheran parish records, Pomerania, early 1800s' retrieves this source. This is what makes MaxSource the semantic routing brain.

coverage.description: What this source covers — drives 'where do I find X' matching.

places.description: Localities this source covers. Mirrors the MaxRecord location shape.

record_types.description: Record types available at this source (open vocabulary; aligns with MaxRecord.record_type where applicable).

languages.description: BCP-47 language codes of the records held (e.g. de, la, en).

access.description: How a harvester reaches the data — the politeness and method contract.

access_method.description: Primary access path. Prefer api/bulk_download over scrape_only when offered.

api_base_url.description: Base URL of the machine-friendly API, when one exists (e.g. MediaWiki api.php, FamilySearch API).

robots_allowed.description: Whether robots.txt permits automated access to the relevant paths.

crawl_notes.description: Politeness/rate-limit/method notes for the harvester (e.g. 'use api.php batched 50/call; 5s/host; no bulk page crawl').

provenance.description: Where this entry came from and whether it is still good.

discovered_via.description: Seed origin of this entry. cyndis_list entries default to visibility=internal_only.

external_ref.description: The originating link, category path, or article title on the seed source.

status.description: Liveness of the pointer. Dead links are marked, not deleted (auditable, like assertion retraction elsewhere in MAXGEN).

asserted_by.description: Agent ID or contributor ID that created/verified this entry.

last_verified_at.description: When the pointer was last confirmed live.

extensions.description: Product/implementation-specific fields live here, never in the core — e.g. harvester_adapter, query_pattern (by_place|by_surname|by_record_id|by_full_text|browse_only), ranking weights, click metrics. Keeps the open standard neutral.
